en-US.description: A tiny Second Life client: a TypeScript / HTML / CSS interface running in a WebView, with a native Rust core (Tauri) doing the heavy lifting underneath. A lightweight buzz into the infinite grid.
en-US.longDescription: A tiny Second Life client: a TypeScript / HTML / CSS interface running in a WebView, with a native Rust core (Tauri) doing the heavy lifting underneath. It does chat, IM (1:1, group, and conference), events, search, radar, map, land, the Destination Guide, and teleport. What it does not do is render the 3D world. Minibee is the friend who comes to the party to talk to people and check the map, not to admire the furniture. Using Minibee requires an existing Second Life or compatible-grid account and connects to the selected grid's services. The Windows desktop build supports purchasing Linden Dollars (L$) with real money through Linden Lab's billing service.

Built for Minibee Viewer 0.13.3. Windows builds are unsigned and will stay that way (SmartScreen may warn - use More info -> Run anyway). Android APK requires sideloading or your own distribution channel. The .aab is the Google Play edition: to comply with Play's virtual-currency billing policy it cannot buy L$ in-app (spending your balance works normally, and the sideload APK keeps the full Buy L$ flow).
How to verify a download
Compare the SHA-256 above with a local hash of the file you downloaded:
certutil -hashfile path\to\installer SHA256
sha256sum path/to/installer
On macOS, shasum -a 256 path/to/installer works too. Abbreviated checksums in the table are the middle-truncated form of the full GitHub release digest.
